relationships.description: The earlier delivery target, such as a release or roadmap phase, is scheduled to be reached before the later one, so the later milestone's scope and date are sequenced after it on the roadmap.
relationships.evidence: A roadmap or release plan (e.g. a Jira fix-version list, GitHub milestone set or roadmap document) shows the first milestone with an earlier target date or an explicit 'after'/'depends on' ordering ahead of the second, for example v1.2 dated before v1.3.
